## Data cleaning for question 1
```{r}
#data cleaning
#only pic the 151 pokemons from the first generation
pokemon_data <- tibble(
  name = character(151),    # Pokemon's name
  height = numeric(151),    # height
  weight = numeric(151),    # weight
  type1 = character(151),   # first type
  type2 = character(151),   # second type (if applicable)
  hp = numeric(151),        # health
  atk = numeric(151),       # physical attack
  def = numeric(151),       # physical defense
  spatk = numeric(151),     # special attack
  spdef = numeric(151),     # special defense
  spd = numeric(151),       # speed
  bst = numeric(151) )     # stat sum of hp through spd - batter strength

for (i in 1:151) {
  
  url <- str_c("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/", i)

  pokemon_response <- GET(url)
  details <- content(pokemon_response, "parsed")
  
 pokemon_data$type1[i] <- details$types[[1]]$type$name
 #if the Pokemon has one more type, that type will be put into type2 column
 if(length(details$types) >= 2)
   {pokemon_data$type2[i] <- details$types[[2]]$type$name}
 else
   #if no second type, the type2 column will be NA
   {pokemon_data$type2[i] <- NA}

  pokemon_data$name[i] <- details$name
  pokemon_data$height[i] <- details$height
  pokemon_data$weight[i] <- details$weight

  #can maybe put in for loop
  #drag out the detial information from states
  pokemon_data$hp[[i]] <- details$stats[[1]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$atk[i] <- details$stats[[2]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$def[i] <- details$stats[[3]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$spatk[i] <- details$stats[[4]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$spdef[i] <- details$stats[[5]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$spd[i] <- details$stats[[6]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$bst[i] <- pokemon_data$hp[i][[1]] + pokemon_data$atk[i][[1]] + pokemon_data$def[i][[1]] + pokemon_data$spatk[i][[1]] + pokemon_data$spdef[i][[1]] + pokemon_data$spd[i][[1]]
}


pokemon_data

```


## Question 1: Is there a relationship between a Pokemon’s physical size, such as height and weight, and its battle strength?

```{r}
#height
pokemon_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = height, y = bst)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Pokemon Height and Battle Strength",
    x = "Height",
    y = "Base Stat Total (BST)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() 

#calculate the correlation
cor(pokemon_data$height, pokemon_data$bst)


#weight
pokemon_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = weight, y = bst)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Pokemon Weight and Battle Strength",
    x = "Weight",
    y = "Base Stat Total (BST)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() 

#calculate the correlation
cor(pokemon_data$weight, pokemon_data$bst)

#height and weight in the same chart, using color to show the bst
pokemon_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = height, y = weight, color = bst)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Battle Strength (BST)") +
  labs(
    title = "Pokemon Physical Size and Battle Strength",
    x = "Height",
    y = "Weight"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#3D plot
plot_ly(data = pokemon_data,
    x = ~height, 
   y = ~weight, 
   z = ~bst,
   size = 3,
   main = "Height, Weight, and Bst",
   xlab = "Height",
   ylab = "Weight",
   zlab = "BST",
   type = "scatter3d")

```


```{r}
#csv file for tibble used in question 1
write_csv(pokemon_data, "pokemon_data.csv")
```


## Question 2: Can we make a tibble to compare the level of base stats among Pokemon of the same type?

```{r}
# Function to set rest of non-Kanto Pokemon's stats to NA values
set_values <- function(num, df){
  df$hp[num] <- NA
  df$atk[num] <- NA
  df$def[num] <- NA
  df$spatk[num] <- NA
  df$spdef[num] <- NA
  df$spd[num] <- NA
  df$bst[num] <- NA
  return(df)
}
```


```{r}
# Function that takes number input from 1-18, referring to type number

 by_type <- function(type_num) {
   # Site link changes url based on type id number
  num_url <- str_c("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/type/", type_num)
  num_response <- GET(num_url)
  num_details <- content(num_response, "parse")
  
  #Create blank tibble to input values to 
  # Through length of how many pokemon are in the type data
  # This tells us how many rows to include in tibble
  # makes computation easier for R.
  
  num_data <- tibble(
    type_name = character(length(num_details$pokemon)), 
    pokemon = character(length(num_details$pokemon)),   
    hp = numeric(length(num_details$pokemon)),          
    atk = numeric(length(num_details$pokemon)),         
    def = numeric(length(num_details$pokemon)),        
    spatk = numeric(length(num_details$pokemon)),      
    spdef = numeric(length(num_details$pokemon)),      
    spd = numeric(length(num_details$pokemon)),         
    bst = numeric(length(num_details$pokemon))          
  )
  
  # Function to input all base stats data of pokemon
  name_to_stat <- function(name, index, df) {
  
    # Accessing through name of pokemon
    helper_url <- str_c("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/", name)
    helper_response <- GET(helper_url)
    helper_details <- content(helper_response, "parse")
  
    # Index is where the pokemon is within the larger tibble 
    # Useful when iterating through for loop
      df$hp[index] <- helper_details$stats[[1]]$base_stat
      df$atk[index] <- helper_details$stats[[2]]$base_stat
      df$def[index] <- helper_details$stats[[3]]$base_stat
      df$spatk[index] <- helper_details$stats[[4]]$base_stat
      df$spdef[index] <- helper_details$stats[[5]]$base_stat
      df$spd[index] <- helper_details$stats[[6]]$base_stat
      df$bst[index] <- df$hp[index][[1]] + df$atk[index][[1]] + df$def[index][[1]] + df$spatk[index][[1]] + df$spdef[index][[1]] + df$spd[index][[1]]
      
      return(df)
    }

  
  for(i in 1:length(num_details$pokemon)){
  
  # If the URL number is greater than 151, this indicates != Kanto
  # Checks a subset of the string that contains the url data
    if(as.numeric(str_sub(num_details$pokemon[[i]]$pokemon$url, 35, str_length(num_details$pokemon[[i]]$pokemon$url) - 1)) <= 151)
      # If it's less than 151, put data in tibble
{num_data$pokemon[i] <- num_details$pokemon[[i]]$pokemon$name
   num_data <- name_to_stat(num_data$pokemon[i], i, num_data)
   num_data$type_name[i] <- num_details$name[1]
} else 
  {
    # Set values to NA 
  num_data$pokemon[i] <- NA
  num_data$type_name[i] <- NA
  num_data <- set_values(i, num_data)
}

  }
# Removing NA values
  num_data |>
    drop_na()
}
```


```{r}
# Iterating through all 18 types, merging into one tibble
all_types <- list_rbind(map(c(1:18), by_type))
```


```{r}
# Summary data showing avg. stats per type in Kanto
mean_all_types <- all_types |>
  group_by(type_name) |>
    summarize(
      mean_atk = mean(atk),
      mean_spatk = mean(spatk),
      mean_def = mean(def),
      mean_spdef = mean(spdef),
      mean_spd = mean(spd),
      mean_hp = mean(hp))
```


```{r}
#csv file for tibble used in question 1
write_csv(all_types, "all_types.csv")
write_csv(mean_all_types, "mean_all_types.csv")
```
